name: LPA eComms access policy
notes: Every route asks for a permission. A user gets a permission only if their user group is listed. Anything not listed is denied (deny by default). Ownership rules (own review, own orders) are checked in code on top of these permissions.

roles.administrator: Administrator - runs the system, manages stock items, invoices and users
roles.user: Staff - daily stock and sales work
roles.customer: Customer - buys in the web store

stock.view.description: See the stock list and item details

stock.adjust.description: Add, remove or reconcile stock quantities

stock.manage.description: Add, edit and delete stock items

clients.view.description: See client records and look them up

users.manage.description: Add, edit, deactivate and delete user accounts

security.view.description: See this policy and the security status page

shop.view.description: Browse the web store and product pages

shop.buy.description: Use the cart and check out

orders.own.description: See your own orders (only your own)

reviews.write.description: Write, edit and delete your own reviews (bought products only)

reviews.vote.description: Mark a review as helpful (not your own)

reviews.moderate.description: Search reviews, hide and publish them
